consultations.clinical_notes: Allergic pharyngitis with localized dental tenderness. Chest bilateral clear. Prescribed antihistamines and analgesics.
consultations.assessment: Good prognosis, responding to oral antihistamines.
consultations.diagnosis: Seasonal Allergic Bronchitis with Mild Pharyngitis
consultations.follow_up_reason: Review symptom resolution and therapeutic response

consultations.clinical_notes: Patient presents with 2-day fever, generalized myalgia, and fatigue. Vitals: Temp 100.2 F, PR 82 bpm, BP 118/76 mmHg. Adequate hydration recommended.
consultations.assessment: Self-limiting viral etiology. Monitor temperature.
consultations.follow_up_reason: Review symptom resolution and therapeutic response

consultations.clinical_notes: Resting arterial pressure 142/90 mmHg. 12-lead ECG normal sinus rhythm without ischemic changes. Advised salt reduction and cardioprotective lifestyle.
consultations.assessment: Borderline grade 1 hypertension. Follow-up blood pressure chart.
consultations.follow_up_reason: Review symptom resolution and therapeutic response

consultations.clinical_notes: Antenatal examination shows normal fundal height corresponding to dates. Fetal Doppler heart sound regular (144 bpm). Maternal vitals stable.
consultations.assessment: Normal antenatal progress. Routine iron-folic acid continuation.
consultations.follow_up_reason: Review symptom resolution and therapeutic response

consultations.clinical_notes: Erythematous pruriginous patches on flexural surfaces of both forearms. No secondary infection or impetiginization. Prescribed topical emollient and mild hydrocortisone.
consultations.assessment: Subacute flare responding to barrier creams.
consultations.follow_up_reason: Review symptom resolution and therapeutic response

consultations.clinical_notes: Follow-up for elevated total cholesterol and low-density lipoproteins. Advised regular brisk walking, dietary fiber enhancement, and statin continuation.
consultations.assessment: Lipid parameters improving with pharmacotherapy.
consultations.follow_up_reason: Review symptom resolution and therapeutic response

consultations.clinical_notes: Slit-lamp biomicroscopy clear. Subjective refraction shows -1.25 DS / -0.50 DC in both eyes. Corrected visual acuity 6/6 bilaterally.
consultations.assessment: Prescribed corrective spectacles with blue-light filter.
consultations.follow_up_reason: Review symptom resolution and therapeutic response

consultations.clinical_notes: Pale, edematous inferior turbinates on anterior rhinoscopy. Clear watery nasal discharge. No sinus tenderness.
consultations.assessment: Allergic rhinitis managed with oral antihistamines.
consultations.follow_up_reason: Review symptom resolution and therapeutic response

consultations.clinical_notes: Mild crepitus on passive flexion of right knee. Radiographs reveal minor medial joint space narrowing. No joint effusion.
consultations.assessment: Mild grade 1 OA. Quadriceps strengthening exercises advised.
consultations.follow_up_reason: Review symptom resolution and therapeutic response

consultations.clinical_notes: Routine checkup. Seated BP 124/80 mmHg on current ACE inhibitor regime. Renal profile within normal limits.
consultations.assessment: Satisfactory arterial pressure control.
consultations.follow_up_reason: Review symptom resolution and therapeutic response

consultations.clinical_notes: Mild tenderness over bilateral maxillary sinuses. Post-nasal drip noted in oropharynx. Prescribed nasal saline irrigation and mucolytic.
consultations.assessment: Subacute sinus congestion without acute bacterial infection.
consultations.follow_up_reason: Review symptom resolution and therapeutic response

consultations.clinical_notes: Comprehensive clinical evaluation. Systemic examination unremarkable. Vitals within optimal ranges.
consultations.assessment: Patient clinically healthy.
consultations.follow_up_reason: Review symptom resolution and therapeutic response

consultations.clinical_notes: Child presents with dry nocturnal cough. Lungs clear with vesicular breath sounds, no rales. Hydration and warm fluids advised.
consultations.assessment: Mild viral bronchitis, resolving course.
consultations.follow_up_reason: Review symptom resolution and therapeutic response

consultations.clinical_notes: Bilateral band-like frontal headache associated with prolonged digital screen exposure and trapezial tenderness. Neurological exam intact.
consultations.assessment: Stress-induced tension headache. Advised posture ergonomics.
consultations.follow_up_reason: Review symptom resolution and therapeutic response

consultations.clinical_notes: Deep carious lesion with thermal hyper-responsiveness. Canal access prepared, working lengths determined, and obturated.
consultations.assessment: Endodontic procedure completed successfully.
consultations.diagnosis: Acute Irreversible Pulpitis (#36 Lower Left Molar)
consultations.follow_up_reason: Review symptom resolution and therapeutic response

consultations.clinical_notes: Occasional premature ventricular contractions noted on Holter monitor. Echocardiogram reveals preserved ejection fraction (62%).
consultations.assessment: Benign palpitations, low cardiovascular risk.
consultations.follow_up_reason: Review symptom resolution and therapeutic response

consultations.clinical_notes: Thyroid panel shows mildly elevated TSH (5.8 mIU/L) with normal free T4. Patient reports lethargy.
consultations.assessment: Mild subclinical hypothyroidism. Repeat TSH in 8 weeks.
consultations.follow_up_reason: Review symptom resolution and therapeutic response

consultations.clinical_notes: Paraspinal muscular spasm in L4-L5 region. Negative straight leg raising test bilaterally. Normal deep tendon reflexes.
consultations.assessment: Acute postural back strain. Prescribed NSAID and lumbar core rest.
consultations.follow_up_reason: Review symptom resolution and therapeutic response

consultations.clinical_notes: Scattered inflammatory papules and comedones over cheeks. Prescribed clindamycin gel and non-comedogenic cleanser.
consultations.assessment: Moderate inflammatory acne responding to topicals.
consultations.follow_up_reason: Review symptom resolution and therapeutic response

consultations.clinical_notes: Otoscopy reveals amber-colored tympanic membrane with impaired mobility. Retracted malleus handle.
